title: Chemipharm
description: Chemipharm is the only company selling directly to 100% of the reachable pharmacies and hospitals in Egypt. Chemipharm's distribution network includes: 12 branches allover Egypt. 100 fixed routes every day. Total 150 visiting all the pharmacies all over the country. Latest News : PROFILE Company Profile: Chemipharm was founded in 1972 by Dr. Gamal Kamel as the first private sector importer of pharmaceutical products in Egypt. Over the last 35 years, Chemipharm has developed and maintained an invaluable reputation as Egypt's most respectable and high standards pharmaceutical distributor. In 2003, based on the company's continuous growth, Chemipharm has established its own manufacturing facility in the 6th of October Industrial Zone. Plant was designed by Pharma Consult. The modern GMP plant produces pharmaceutical products of all major forms (tablets, capsules, syrups and ointments).
